annotations.title: Share a report by public link

description: Make a public link to a ready report, as the report page's Share does. Anyone who has the link and its password can read the report and download its PDF without signing in, outside the organization too, until the link expires or is revoked. Only do this when the user asks to share the report. A report has one link: sharing it again replaces the earlier link and password, which stop working. Returns the link and the password once; QualiLoop keeps only a hash of each and cannot show them again. Give both to the user and nowhere else. Revoke the link with unshare_report.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the link stops working: 7, 30, 90 or 365; null for never.
expires_in_days.title: Expires In Days

password.description: The password the link asks for, 8 to 128 characters. Leave it out to have a strong one made.
password.title: Password

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

report.description: The report's id, as list_reports shows it.
report.title: Report

name: share_report
